feed.title: Greek News Aggregator — Daily Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top headlines from kathimerini.gr

entry.title: Αλέξης Τσίπρας: Στόχος να κερδίσουμε την κυβέρνηση Μητσοτάκη
entry.summary: At a Chalandri event for his 'Governing Left' project, former PM Alexis Tsipras escalated his rhetoric, saying the new goal is to 'defeat the Mitsotakis government' rather than merely strengthen opposition. He attacked the wiretap scandal, the energy market, and what he called 'profiteering' by banks.

entry.title: Η αμερικανική Blackstone εξαγόρασε τη Skroutz
entry.summary: US private equity giant Blackstone has acquired Skroutz, Greece's largest online marketplace, after 20 years of independent growth. The deal aims to turn Skroutz into a regional e-commerce powerhouse for southeastern Europe.

entry.title: Σκιές στις σχέσεις με το Κίεβο λόγω του drone
entry.summary: Greek-Ukrainian relations have been seriously strained by the Magura naval drone found in Lefkada with explosives aboard, apparently destined to strike a Russian 'shadow-fleet' tanker. Athens fears the conflict is spilling into the Ionian and Mediterranean, with potential damage to maritime security and tourism.

entry.title: Ο Τραμπ ψάχνει μια «νίκη» στη συνάντηση με Σι
entry.summary: Donald Trump travels to Beijing with diminished leverage for his summit with Xi Jinping, after the Iran conflict and court rulings against his tariffs eroded his bargaining position. He is now seeking modest wins on soybeans, beef and Boeing plus Chinese help on Iran, with Taiwan still in play.

entry.title: Δένδιας: Η υπόθεση του drone θα τεθεί στον Ουκρανό υπουργό Αμυνας
entry.summary: Greek Defence Minister Nikos Dendias is raising the Lefkada drone incident at the EU Defence Council, telling counterparts that the Magura-type unmanned surface vessel is now confirmed to be Ukrainian. He will press the issue directly with Ukraine's defence minister, who is attending via video link.

entry.title: Βρετανία: «Δεν παραιτούμαι», λέει ο Στάρμερ
entry.summary: British PM Keir Starmer told his cabinet he will not resign amid mounting Labour pressure after Community Minister Miatta Fahnbulleh quit and called on him to set a timetable for stepping down. Housing Minister Steve Reed urged the party to back him, saying 'this is not a game'.

entry.title: Τουρκία: Μήνυμα προς την Αθήνα οι «διαρροές» περί νόμου για τις θαλάσσιες ζώνες
entry.summary: Turkey's Milliyet confirms Ankara is drafting a maritime-zones law covering its continental shelf and EEZ in the Aegean and the Mediterranean — the so-called 'Blue Homeland' doctrine. The leak is widely read in Athens as a warning shot, though Turkish sources urge waiting for the final text.

entry.title: Τα ακριβά λιπάσματα φέρνουν νέο κύμα αυξήσεων στα τρόφιμα
entry.summary: Moody's Analytics warns Europe faces another food-price shock in autumn 2026 and into 2027 as soaring fertiliser costs from the Middle East war filter through to consumers. Food inflation is set to worsen with the next harvest cycle.

entry.title: Δημοσκόπηση: Ανησυχία για το κράτος δικαίου, ψήφος διαμαρτυρίας για 6 στους 10
entry.summary: An Alco poll for Alpha TV finds 72% of Greeks do not believe the rule of law functions in their country and nearly 8 in 10 say laws are applied 'selectively'. Six in ten now plan to cast a protest vote, while 64% support EU prosecutor Laura Kovesi's intervention in the OPEKEPE case.

entry.title: Η Ε.Ε αλλάζει στρατηγική στα φάρμακα: Προτεραιότητα στην ευρωπαϊκή παραγωγή και την ασφάλεια εφοδιασμού
entry.summary: After marathon talks, the European Parliament and Council reached a landmark deal on the Critical Medicines Act, prioritising European production and supply security over price. The law responds to pandemic-era shortages and Europe's reliance on India and China for active pharmaceutical ingredients.

entry.title: Ν.Δ.: Συνέδριο και στο βάθος κάλπες
entry.summary: New Democracy opens its 16th party congress on Friday to mobilise the machine ahead of elections that could be called in 2026 or 2027. PM Kyriakos Mitsotakis is pushing for cohesion after seven years in power, with insiders acknowledging weakened structures and growing internal discontent.

entry.title: Unicef: Ενα παιδί σκοτώνεται κάθε εβδομάδα στη Δυτική Οχθη
entry.summary: Unicef says at least one Palestinian child has been killed on average every week in the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem since January 2025, totalling 70 deaths. Spokesperson James Elder denounced the 'unbearable price' children pay as Israeli military operations escalate.

entry.title: Κόφτες στο Airbnb με το νέο χωροταξικό του τουρισμού
entry.summary: Greece's draft tourism land-use framework allows local bans or caps on Airbnb-style short-term rentals in oversaturated islands and zones, and counts those beds toward an area's tourism carrying capacity. The plan is now in a two-week informal public consultation.

entry.title: Μεταναστευτικό: Αύξηση των αφίξεων σε Κρήτη και Γαύδο
entry.summary: More than 600 migrants reached Crete and Gavdos in recent days, with local authorities sounding alarms ahead of the summer. Arrivals on this North-African route hit 19,948 last year — nearly four times the 2024 figure.

entry.title: Βρετανία: Παραιτήθηκε υπουργός – Κάλεσε τον Στάρμερ να ορίσει χρονοδιάγραμμα αποχώρησης
entry.summary: British Communities Minister Miatta Fahnbulleh resigned, urging PM Keir Starmer to set a clear timetable for stepping down. She is the first minister to quit over the Labour leadership crisis, raising the stakes for Starmer's premiership.

entry.title: Σχοινάς-Πιτσιλής: Πάνω από 2,2 δισ. ευρώ σε 600.000 αγρότες – «Το πάρτι για τους επιτήδειους τελείωσε»
entry.summary: Agriculture Minister Margaritis Schinas and tax-authority chief Giorgos Pitsilis pledged that 600,000 farmers will receive €2.231 bn by end-2026 despite the absorption of payments agency OPEKEPE into the AADE. Schinas called the reform 'strategic' and declared the 'party is over for opportunists' who abused the system.

entry.title: Καμπάνια επιρροής από το Ισραήλ για τη Eurovision
entry.summary: A New York Times investigation alleges Israel ran a state-funded, multi-layered influence campaign around Eurovision — using diplomatic networks, public funds and organised vote drives — turning the contest into a soft-power tool during the Gaza war.

entry.title: ΑΠΘ: Επίθεση με ρόπαλα και κράνη σε φοιτητές [βίντεο]
entry.summary: Anti-authoritarian assailants attacked left-wing student activists with clubs and helmets at the Aristotle University in Thessaloniki, hitting the Polytechnic, Law and Economics schools. Seven students were hospitalised with fractures and contusions; police detained eight people and riot units moved onto campus.

entry.title: Προβλέψεις για δύο αυξήσεις επιτοκίων φέτος από ΕΚΤ
entry.summary: Bloomberg's panel of economists now expects the ECB to deliver two 25-bp rate hikes in 2026, in June and September, as the Iran war pushes inflation to 2.9%. The deposit rate is currently 2% and inflation is not expected to return to the 2% target until 2028.

entry.title: Ζελένσκι και Palantir ενισχύουν τη χρήση της ΑΙ στον πόλεμο
entry.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky met Palantir CEO Alex Karp as Kyiv expands AI use in the war. The 'Brave1 Dataroom' programme leverages combat data collected since 2022 to build AI tools that detect and intercept Russian drones.
